arm: Arm S12: Logarithmic LMR with History Modulation
hypothesis: Now that TT-first, Continuation History (S8), Late Move Pruning (S9), and SEE capture segregation (S11) provide high-accuracy move ordering, logarithmic LMR with history modulation safely reduces late quiet non-checking moves by multiple plies, allowing the search to reach ~1 ply deeper at equal time control.
